name: pi-container-sandbox
description: pi coding-agent extension that runs every read/write/edit/bash op inside a per-session Linux container (Apple `container` or Docker).
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

scripts.build-image: which container >/dev/null 2>&1 && container build -t thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:latest -f docker/Dockerfile docker || docker build -t thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:latest -f docker/Dockerfile docker
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:$(bun -e "process.stdout.write(require('./package.json').version)") -t thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:latest -f docker/Dockerfile docker
scripts.docker:publish: docker push thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:$(bun -e "process.stdout.write(require('./package.json').version)") && docker push thegreataxios/pi-sandbox:latest
scripts.docker:release: bun run docker:build && bun run docker:publish
